attributes.title: Codex CLI — Conversations
attributes.description: Logs-based usage summary — one row per Codex conversation (STATS BY labels.conversation_id) over logs-apm.app.codex_cli_rs*. An ES|QL saved Discover session (no data view / filter pills). Rolls up the trace_safe event family and the log_only token-usage docs into per-conversation totals: first/last seen, wall-clock duration (sec), doc count, distinct turns (traces), distinct user prompts, LLM requests (trace_safe codex.api_request scoped to the /responses endpoint — /models excluded), tool calls (distinct codex.tool_result call ids), cached vs non-cached input and output token sums, and error count. Sorted by last_seen DESC. The session-level companion to Turns (per-turn, traces-based).

kibanaSavedObjectMeta.searchSourceJSON:
{"query":{"esql":"FROM logs-apm.app.codex_cli_rs*
 | WHERE labels.conversation_id IS NOT NULL
 | EVAL ts_ms = TO_LONG(@timestamp)
 | EVAL is_log_only = service.framework.name == "codex_otel.log_only"
 | EVAL is_trace_safe = labels.target == "codex_otel.trace_safe"
 | EVAL is_user_prompt = is_trace_safe AND labels.event_name == "codex.user_prompt"
 | EVAL is_llm_request = is_trace_safe AND labels.event_name == "codex.api_request" AND labels.endpoint == "/responses"
 | EVAL is_tool_result = is_trace_safe AND labels.event_name == "codex.tool_result"
 | EVAL is_token_usage = is_log_only AND labels.input_token_count IS NOT NULL
 | EVAL cached_input_token_count = CASE(is_token_usage, numeric_labels.cached_token_count, null)
 | EVAL non_cached_input_token_count = CASE(is_token_usage, TO_LONG(labels.input_token_count) - numeric_labels.cached_token_count, null)
 | EVAL output_token_count = CASE(is_token_usage, TO_LONG(labels.output_token_count), null)
 | EVAL is_error = labels.success == "false" OR labels.error_message IS NOT NULL
 | STATS
     first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
     last_seen = MAX(@timestamp),
     duration_sec = (MAX(ts_ms) - MIN(ts_ms)) / 1000.0,
     docs = COUNT(*),
     turns = COUNT_DISTINCT(trace.id),
     user_prompts = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(is_user_prompt, span.id, null)),
     llm_requests = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(is_llm_request, span.id, null)),
     tool_calls = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(is_tool_result, labels.call_id, null)),
     cached_input_tokens = SUM(cached_input_token_count),
     non_cached_input_tokens = SUM(non_cached_input_token_count),
     output_tokens = SUM(output_token_count),
     errors = SUM(CASE(is_error, 1, 0))
   BY conversation_id = labels.conversation_id
 | SORT last_seen DESC"},"filter":[]}

attributes.title: Codex CLI — Turns
attributes.description: Traces-based turn summary — one row per Codex trace (STATS BY trace.id) over traces-apm-agents_codex_cli_rs*, joined with codex.turn_ttft log events from logs-apm.app.codex_cli_rs*. An ES|QL saved Discover session (no data view / filter pills). Groups by trace.id rather than labels.turn_id so traces stay visible even when child spans (op.dispatch.user_input, shell_command) don't carry a turn_id. For each trace: first/last seen, the session_task.turn span duration (sec), time-to-first-token (ttft_sec, from the trace_safe codex.turn_ttft log event associated by trace.id), distinct user prompts (op.dispatch.user_input), LLM requests (try_run_sampling_request), tool catalogues built (built_tools), and tool calls (shell_command + mcp.tools.call combined), turn-level token usage (cached / non-cached input, output) summed without double counting, error count (event.outcome == failure), conversation_id (labels.thread_id), and trace id. Sorted by last_seen DESC. The turn-level companion to Conversations (per-conversation, logs-based).

kibanaSavedObjectMeta.searchSourceJSON:
{"query":{"esql":"FROM traces-apm-agents_codex_cli_rs*, logs-apm.app.codex_cli_rs*
 | WHERE transaction.name == "turn/start" OR span.name IN ("session_task.turn", "op.dispatch.user_input", "try_run_sampling_request", "built_tools", "shell_command", "mcp.tools.call") OR (labels.target == "codex_otel.trace_safe" AND labels.event_name == "codex.turn_ttft")
 | EVAL is_session_turn = span.name == "session_task.turn"
 | EVAL is_ttft = labels.target == "codex_otel.trace_safe" AND labels.event_name == "codex.turn_ttft"
 | EVAL is_user_prompt = span.name == "op.dispatch.user_input"
 | EVAL is_llm_request = span.name == "try_run_sampling_request"
 | EVAL is_tool_catalogue = span.name == "built_tools"
 | EVAL is_shell_command = span.name == "shell_command"
 | EVAL is_mcp_call = span.name == "mcp.tools.call"
 | EVAL is_tool_call = is_shell_command OR is_mcp_call
 | EVAL is_error = event.outcome == "failure"
 | STATS
     first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
     last_seen = MAX(@timestamp),
     duration_sec = MAX(CASE(is_session_turn, span.duration.us / 1000000.0, null)),
     ttft_sec = MAX(CASE(is_ttft, TO_LONG(labels.duration_ms) / 1000.0, null)),
     user_prompts = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(is_user_prompt, span.id, null)),
     llm_requests = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(is_llm_request, span.id, null)),
     tool_catalogues = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(is_tool_catalogue, span.id, null)),
     tool_calls = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(is_tool_call, span.id, null)),
     cached_input_tokens = SUM(numeric_labels.codex_turn_token_usage_cached_input_tokens),
     non_cached_input_tokens = SUM(numeric_labels.codex_turn_token_usage_non_cached_input_tokens),
     output_tokens = SUM(numeric_labels.codex_turn_token_usage_output_tokens),
     errors = SUM(CASE(is_error, 1, 0)),
     conversation_id = VALUES(labels.thread_id)
   BY trace_id = trace.id
 | SORT last_seen DESC"},"filter":[]}
